maria_docs: FYI I opened a tiny PR to consolidate the Optimize toolkit docs for batching + KV prefetch + quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4982 Can folks eyeball the SDK example and the migration note? Need reviewers before EOD. Thanks!

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #4982 — lint ✓, tests running (15m ETA).

sam_opt: on it. I'll check the recommendations. Quick Q: do we keep the \"aggressive\" quant profile as the sample default?

liz_sdk: I vote no. Default should be `latency-balanced`. Aggressive reduces quality too much for a first example. Also the SDK snippet is missing the `kv_prefetch=True` param — users will copy/paste and hit surprises.

jonathan: adding a tiny example quant profile (we can inline in the docs):
```json
{"name":"latency-balanced","bits":8,"prefetch_kv":true,"max_batch":16}
```
Change suggestion: set `max_batch` to 8 for conversational workloads to keep tail latency acceptable.

kevin_qa: CI flagged a docs build error: linkcheck failed on /optimize/kv-prefetch — 404. I can fix but want the author to sign off on the redirect target.

maria_docs: thanks — fixing link, lowering `max_batch` to 8 in the sample, and will add both profiles (latency-balanced and aggressive) with a short compare note. Pushing a follow-up commit in ~5.

liz_sdk: LGTM on showing both profiles, but please add a line that the snippet requires SDK >=1.4.0 since param names changed in 1.4.0.

maria_docs: good catch. I'll add `Requires SDK >=1.4.0` in the caption and update the sample file. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: CI update: docs build ✓, linkcheck ✓, samplegen tests failed (1): examples/optimize/sample_batch.py:42 - unused import.

kevin_qa: grabbing that test fix now, will remove the unused import and run `pytest examples/optimize -q` locally.

kevin_qa: tests pass locally after the fix. Ready for merge when the SDK note is in.

maria_docs: added the SDK note and a tiny typo fix. PTAL @sam_opt @liz_sdk.

sam_opt: quick review done, left two tiny inline nits (wording). :thumbsup:

liz_sdk: approved. :rocket:

maria_docs: merging in 2 min unless any objections.

jonathan: none from me, looks good — thanks team.
